xdelta3 (DJW secondary-compression decoder)
===========================================

What is here
  djw_decode.h / djw_decode.cpp   decoder for xdelta3's "DJW" static multi-table Huffman secondary compression
                                  (VCDIFF secondary compressor ID 1), used by src/common/patcher_vcdiff.cpp.
  fgk_decode.h / fgk_decode.cpp   decoder for the FGK adaptive Huffman compression (ID 16), from xdelta3-fgk.h, same terms.
  LICENSE                         the Apache License 2.0 text, verbatim from the upstream tag below.

Where it comes from
  Project : xdelta3, https://github.com/jmacd/xdelta  (Joshua P. MacDonald)
  Tag     : v3.2.2   (commit 5f8f5a5531...), file xdelta3/xdelta3-djw.h
  Archive : https://github.com/jmacd/xdelta/archive/refs/tags/v3.2.2.tar.gz
            SHA-256 995319ccb7fe721a523fb3142376f5813093685b1cc302d07018ca97d2584af2
  Licence : Apache License 2.0, "Copyright 2016 Joshua MacDonald" (see the header of every xdelta3 source file at this tag).
            Apache-2.0 code may be combined into a GPL-3.0-or-later work such as RetroHub; the combined work is GPL-3.0-or-later.

Licence check at the pinned tag (done 2026-11-01)
  v3.1.0 is NOT Apache: its COPYING is the GPL v2 and every source header says "version 2 of the License, or (at your option)
  any later version". The Apache-2.0 relicensing starts with v3.2.0. v3.2.2 (the newest tag when this was vendored) has an
  Apache-2.0 LICENSE file and Apache-2.0 headers in all files, including the ones read here. v3.0.x is GPL-2.0-or-later.
  Either licence is compatible with RetroHub's GPL-3.0-or-later; the Apache one needs only this notice and the LICENSE text.

What was changed (Apache-2.0 section 4(b))
  Only the decoder was taken, and it was rewritten rather than copied: self-contained C++17 (std::vector, no xd3_stream),
  every array index and every bit read is range-checked (xdelta3 asserts that its callers did that), run lengths and
  selector values are validated. The bit order, the table layouts and the move-to-front / run-length scheme are unchanged,
  so the output is identical for every stream xdelta3 can write. Verified against streams written by xdelta3 v3.2.2 built
  from the same tag (src/common/testdata/patcher/x_*.xdelta) and on a 33 MB patch of a 64 MB ROM.
  The rest of xdelta3 (the VCDIFF reader and the encoder) is NOT used: RetroHub's VCDIFF decoder is written from RFC 3284.

Not supported on purpose
  xdelta3's own LZMA secondary compression needs liblzma; RetroHub reads those streams with the public-domain LZMA SDK
  decoder in third_party/lzma instead.
